name: ninjatheme
description: NinjaTheme WordPress standalone theme with SCSS support

scripts.build:watch: sass scss/style.scss style.css && concurrently --kill-others "npm run sass:watch" "npm run postcss:watch"
scripts.build:prod: NODE_ENV=production sass scss/style.scss:style.css scss/critical.scss:critical.css --style=compressed --no-source-map && NODE_ENV=production postcss style.css assets/css/bulma.min.css critical.css -r
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently --kill-others "npm run build:watch" "browser-sync start --config bs-config.js"
